name: StepHeroNFTs referral-claim reentrancy
summary: claimReferral(address) sent the caller's accrued BNB referral commission before reducing its recorded balance, so the attack contract's receive hook could reenter and claim the same self-referral commission repeatedly.
notes: The defect-bearing StepHeroNFTs runtime was created directly in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the pre-exploit block; the exploit trace executes it directly without a target-originated delegatecall.

Gross loss is the contract's native BNB depletion: 138 BNB in the anchor (1,000 BNB in through buyAsset(), 1,138 BNB out through reentrant claimReferral() calls) plus 0.69 BNB in the copycat. The 0.1 BNB flash-loan fee is attacker financing, not victim depletion.

0x14ca527f by a different EOA (0x97d8170e) repeats the same buyAsset/claimReferral reentrancy 87 minutes later and takes the last 0.69 BNB; the contract's internal-transaction history since deployment shows no earlier multi-payout claim.
